kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

lines.say: Mind still racing tonight? Hear this.
Be still, and know that I am God:
lines.big: Be still, and know that I am God:

lines.say: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth. Psalm forty six, verse ten.
lines.big: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

lines.say: Still doesn't mean you quit. It means you let him be God for the night.
lines.big: Still doesn't mean you quit. It means you let him be God for the night.

lines.say: Lord, I'm being still tonight. You are God, and I'm not. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 32 through 56, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
lines.small: Psalms 32–56, read slowly. Link in the description.
